name: Speed of Sound
tagline: Voice typing for the Linux desktop
blurb: Speed of Sound is a voice-typing app for the Linux desktop.
description:
Speed of Sound is a voice-typing app for the Linux desktop.

By default, transcription runs entirely on-device, so no audio ever leaves your machine.
The app ships with a built-in multilingual Whisper model and supports additional models from the
Whisper, Parakeet, and Canary families to improve accuracy.

• Offline, private transcription with popular open speech models (Whisper, Parakeet, Canary)

• Multiple activation options: click the in-app button or use a global keyboard shortcut

• Types directly into any app via XDG Desktop Portals (supports X11 and Wayland)

• Optional text polishing with LLMs, supports self-hosted services like Ollama, vLLM, and llama.cpp

• Optional cloud providers supported for resource-constrained hardware environments

Please visit speedofsound.io/getting-started after installation.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
